findings.problem: The PDF is 9 pages, about 8.35 pages of content. The fact sheet (C) plans 7 pages including references, and RA-L allows at most 8. To reach 7 pages, about 1.35 pages (2.7 columns, roughly 165 text lines) must go. To reach 8 pages, at least 0.35 page must go.
findings.evidence:
Build: I copied papers/ to scratchpad/review-form/build and ran `tectonic --keep-logs --keep-intermediates main.tex`. It exits 0 with no errors and no undefined refs or cites. `pdfinfo main.pdf` gives Pages: 9, letter. The body ends on p8 at y=683 pt ("other feature extractors."). References fill the p8 right column and the p9 left column down to about y=530. I measured each part's size from the heading positions (`pdftotext -bbox`; one column is about 680 pt), so these sizes are approximate:
- Abstract and keywords: about 0.3 column.
- Intro: about 1.75 columns, plus Fig. 1 at about 0.65 column.
- Related Work: about 1.2 columns.
- Method, with Fig. 2 and Alg. 1: about 3.8 columns.
- Setup and Metrics: about 2.6 columns.
- Results, ablations, timing, limitations and conclusion, with Tables I-IV and Figs. 3-4: about 4.4 columns.
- References: about 1.75 columns.
Rendered pages are in scratchpad/review-form/png/p-1..9.png.
findings.fix:
Candidate cuts with estimated savings:
(a) Intro paragraph 2 (L171-191, about 0.37 column) repeats Related Work L249-285 almost item by item: CSS future work, LatentBKI, LEGaussians, LAMP and NormLift. Cut it to 5-6 lines (saves about 0.25 column).
(b) The contributions (L206-233, about 0.62 column) repeat the abstract and the Method. Bullet 4 is prior work (joseph2025gradbp). Rewrite as 3 short bullets (about 0.3 column).
(c) The Conclusion (L961-971, about 0.25 column) restates the abstract. Cut it to 3 sentences (about 0.15 column).
(d) Replace Table IV and Sec. IV-F (L908-940, about 0.35 column) with two sentences (about 0.3 column).
(e) Tighten Setup and Metrics: the RIO10 protocol (L581-599, about 0.4 column), change baselines (L631-649, about 0.42 column) and metrics (L654-698, about 0.86 column). Compress the tie and coverage rules and the NCC and Yager descriptions (about 0.5 column).
(f) The "Predictive P0/P1/P2" rows of Table III (L862-864) duplicate Table I, and one of them equals "Full method" (about 0.05 column).
(g) IEEEtran prints every author: [22] Replica takes 8 lines, and [2], [4], [6], [7], [28] and [35] take 3-4 lines each. IEEE style allows "et al." after 6 authors. Add an IEEEtranBSTCTL entry (CTLuse_forced_etal="yes", CTLmax_names_forced_etal="6", CTLnames_show_etal="1") plus \bstctlcite (about 0.2 column).
(h) Remove the repetitions in the next finding (about 0.3 column).
(i) Shorten the Fig. 1 caption (5 full-width lines) and the Fig. 2 caption (8 lines) (about 0.15 column).
These cuts total about 2.2 columns. The rest has to come from the Method, for example by folding Sec. III-H (L541-552, prior-work identity) into III-C, or from RIO10 if access fails.

findings.problem:
The integrator's report did not list these symbol clashes:
- k is the persistence window (k=2) and also the number of mapping frames in the uncertainty-ranking protocol. Both uses sit in the Experiments section.
- p is the pixel inside the probability p(c | p).
- Bold u is the view mean, while u_n and u_p are uncertainties.
- a is the P2 coefficient, while a_0 is the view-mass fraction.
- The text says "index n dropped" but the next display keeps R_n.
findings.evidence:
- k: "persist over k=2 observed views" (L633), "No persistence (k=1)" (Tab. III), "built from k of the 180 mapping frames ... wrong at k frames" (L674-676), and "k in {10,30,90}" in the Fig. 3 box.
- p: "p(c | p)=softmax_c(...)" (L522 and Fig. 1 box 8).
- u: "Here u_p averages u_n" (L533) next to bold u_{v,n} (L361).
- R_n: "(index n dropped): R_n = sum omega u" (L364-366).
findings.fix: Call the frame count M ("fields built from M of the 180 frames"). Write the predictive as p(y_p=c) or index pixels by i. Keep the superscripts in the P2 sentence (u^{(.)}_p). Rename the P2 coefficients, for example a_e and a_a. Drop the subscript n in the L366 display or drop "(index n dropped)".
